options.label: One or more lights do not work (others OK)

te-q2.text: Are the towing vehicle light switches set correctly, and do the towing vehicle lights work? (Step 1)

te-a1.text: Set the towing vehicle light switches
te-a1.actionText: Set the light switches in the towing vehicle to the correct positions (see the towing vehicle operator manual) and recheck the trailer lights.

te-q3.text: Do the trailer lights work now?

te-a2.actionText: Pull the intervehicular power cable connector out and reset it fully into the towing vehicle receptacle (Step 2). Check the connector plug for dirty or corroded contacts and clean them as required (Step 3).

te-q4.text: Do the trailer lights work now?

te-q4b.text: Inspect the intervehicular cable and wiring harness (Step 5). Do you see broken wires or loose connections?

te-t1.text: Trailer lights restored (switch settings / connector reseated or cleaned).

terminal.summary: Trailer lights restored — switches set or connector reseated/cleaned

te-t2.text: Broken wires or loose connections in the cable/harness. Notify Unit maintenance. Trailer lights that do not operate properly are NMC (PMCS item 8).

terminal.summary: Trailer lights inoperative — cable/harness damage, NMC

te-t3.text: All trailer lights still inoperative with no visible damage. Notify Unit maintenance (malfunction 1). NMC per PMCS item 8.

terminal.summary: All trailer lights inoperative — needs maintenance, NMC

te-q5.actionText: Check the intervehicular power cable connector for dirty or corroded contacts and clean as required (malfunction 2, Step 1). Recheck the lights.

te-q6.text: Do the affected lights work now?

te-q7.text: Check the affected light for loose or broken wires or a loose connection (Step 2). What do you find?

options.label: Nothing visible — lamp just does not light

te-t4.text: Affected lights restored after cleaning the connector contacts.

terminal.summary: Trailer light restored — connector contacts cleaned

te-t5.text: Loose or broken wiring at the affected light. Notify Unit maintenance. NMC per PMCS item 8 (trailer lights do not operate properly).

terminal.summary: Trailer light inoperative — wiring at light, NMC

te-t6.text: Affected light still inoperative. Notify Unit maintenance. NMC per PMCS item 8.

terminal.summary: Trailer light inoperative — needs maintenance, NMC

te-q8.actionText: Check the intervehicular power cable connector for dirty or corroded contacts and clean as required (malfunction 3, Step 1).

te-q9.text: Are the lights now steady and at normal brightness?

te-q10.text: Check for loose wires or connections at the affected light (Step 2). What do you find?

te-t7.text: Dim/flickering lights corrected by cleaning the connector contacts.

terminal.summary: Dim/flickering trailer lights — contacts cleaned

te-t8.text: Loose wiring at the light. Notify Unit maintenance. NMC per PMCS item 8.

terminal.summary: Dim/flickering trailer lights — loose wiring, NMC

te-t9.text: Lights still dim or flickering with no visible cause. Notify Unit maintenance. NMC per PMCS item 8.

terminal.summary: Dim/flickering trailer lights — needs maintenance, NMC

options.label: Brakes will not release — trailer drags
Brakes will not hold the trailer when engaged

tb-q2.text: Check both handbrake levers. Are they fully RELEASED — in the RAISED position? (Step 1)

options.label: No — one or both levers are not fully raised

tb-a1.text: Release the handbrake levers (raise them fully)
tb-a1.actionText: Raise both handbrake levers fully to the RELEASED (raised) position. WARNING: before releasing, make sure the trailer is coupled to the towing vehicle or the wheels are chocked (para 2-8.1) so it cannot roll.

tb-q2b.text: Are the brakes released now (wheels turn freely)?

tb-q3.text: Is the breakaway lever engaged (not in the DOWN position)? (Step 2)

tb-a2.actionText: Reset the breakaway lever to its normal DOWN position (PMCS item 2d). Check the breakaway cable for damage.

tb-t1.text: Handbrake levers were not fully released (raised). Raised them and the brakes release.

terminal.summary: Brakes dragging — handbrake levers fully raised (released)

tb-t2.text: Brakes still will not release. Do not tow. Notify Unit maintenance (malfunction 4).

terminal.summary: Trailer brakes will not release — NMC

tb-t3.text: Breakaway lever was engaged; reset it and the brakes release. The TM also says notify Unit maintenance (malfunction 4, Step 2) — have the breakaway system checked.

terminal.summary: Breakaway lever engaged — reset, notify Unit maintenance

tb-q5.text: Are both handbrake levers fully ENGAGED — in the LOWERED position? (malfunction 5, Step 1)

tb-a3.text: Engage the handbrake levers (lower them fully)
tb-a3.actionText: Lower both handbrake levers fully to the ENGAGED (lowered) position. Chock the wheels (para 2-8.1) before testing whether the trailer holds.

tb-t5.text: Handbrake levers were not fully engaged (lowered). Lowered them and the trailer holds.

terminal.summary: Brakes not holding — handbrake levers fully lowered (engaged)

tb-t4.text: Brakes will not hold the trailer with the levers fully engaged (lowered). Keep the wheels chocked. Notify Unit maintenance. NMC: handbrake fails to operate correctly (PMCS items 4/7).

terminal.summary: Trailer brakes will not hold — NMC

tb-q6.text: Check the fluid level in the hydraulic brake actuator master cylinder (proper level is 1/8 in. (3 mm) below the top edge). Is it low? (malfunction 6, Step 1)

tb-a4.actionText: Add brake fluid to 1/8 in. (3 mm) below the top edge of the reservoir (Appendix G). Do not let water or dirt into the master cylinder.

tb-q7.text: Check the brake tubes and hoses for leaks (Step 2). Any leak?

tb-t6.text: Brake fluid leak. Any brake fluid leakage must be corrected (para 2-6) — NMC (PMCS items 13/19). Do not tow. Notify Unit maintenance.

terminal.summary: Trailer brake fluid leak — NMC

tb-q8.text: Do the hydraulic brakes operate now?

tb-t7.text: Hydraulic brakes operate; fluid level corrected/verified with no leaks. Recheck the level at the next PMCS — fluid loss without a visible leak should be reported.

terminal.summary: Hydraulic brakes operate — fluid level corrected, no leaks

tb-t8.text: Hydraulic brakes still do not operate. Do not tow. Notify Unit maintenance (malfunction 6).

terminal.summary: Trailer hydraulic brakes inoperative — NMC

tb-q9.text: Is the handbrake lever seized, or is it damaged? (malfunction 7)

tb-a5.actionText: Clean the lever as required and lubricate it in accordance with Appendix G (Step 1). Work the lever through its range. Adjust if necessary (para 2-14).

tb-q10.text: Does the handbrake lever engage (lowered) and release (raised) properly now?

tb-t9.text: Handbrake lever damaged or still inoperative. Notify Unit maintenance. NMC: handbrake fails to operate correctly (PMCS items 4/7).

terminal.summary: Handbrake lever inoperative/damaged — NMC

tb-t10.text: Seized handbrake lever cleaned and lubricated; it operates correctly.

terminal.summary: Seized handbrake lever — cleaned/lubricated, operates

ttd-q1.text: What is the tire or wheel problem?

options.label: Flat, deflated, or will not hold air
Cut, gouge, crack, bulge, or sidewall damage that could fail
Wheel wobbles / lug nuts loose or missing

ttd-t6.text: A deflated or unserviceable tire is NMC (PMCS items 5/6). Notify Unit maintenance. (Runflat inserts allow emergency towing only: max 30 mph; max 20 mph for 30 miles with both tires flat — para 2-23.)

terminal.summary: Trailer tire flat/deflated — NMC

ttd-t7.text: Leaks, cuts, gouges, cracks, or bulges which would result in tire failure are NMC (PMCS items 5/6). Notify Unit maintenance.

terminal.summary: Trailer tire cut/gouge/crack/bulge — NMC

ttd-t8.text: A missing tire is NMC (PMCS items 5/6).

terminal.summary: Trailer tire missing — NMC

ttd-q2.text: Check tire pressure (malfunction 8). Is it 17 psi ± 2 psi (117 ± 13.8 kPa)?

ttd-a1.actionText: Inflate the tire to 17 psi ± 2 psi (117 ± 13.8 kPa).

ttd-t1.text: Uneven wear with correct pressure. Notify Unit maintenance (malfunction 8). Uneven wear alone is not an NMC criterion unless the tire is unserviceable.

terminal.summary: Uneven trailer tire wear — notify Unit maintenance

ttd-t2.text: Tire inflated to 17 psi. The TM also says notify Unit maintenance about the abnormal wear (malfunction 8).

terminal.summary: Uneven tire wear — pressure corrected, notify Unit maintenance

ttd-q4.text: Check for missing or loose stud nuts or lugnuts (malfunction 9). How many are missing on that wheel?

options.label: None or fewer than three missing / some loose

ttd-t3.text: Three or more lugnuts or stud nuts missing is NMC (PMCS items 12/15). Notify Unit maintenance.

terminal.summary: Three or more lugnuts missing — NMC

ttd-a2.actionText: Replace missing nuts and tighten loose nuts. Notify Unit maintenance to apply proper torque (malfunction 9).

ttd-t4.text: Loose/missing nuts replaced or tightened. Unit maintenance must apply proper torque.

terminal.summary: Wobbly wheel — nuts tightened, Unit maintenance to torque

ttd-t5.text: Wheel still wobbles after tightening — possible hub/bearing damage. Do not tow. Notify Unit maintenance.

terminal.summary: Wobbly trailer wheel — needs maintenance

tsl-q1.text: The front support leg will not crank up or down, or the caster does not move freely. Check the leg for dents and damage (malfunction 10). Is it dented or damaged?

tsl-t1.text: Front support leg damaged. Notify Unit maintenance (malfunction 10). WARNING: loaded tongue weight is up to 420 lb — remove the load or use four or more persons to lift the drawbar (PMCS item 3). The TM gives no NMC criterion for this item.

terminal.summary: Front support leg damaged/inoperative — notify Unit maintenance

tsl-t2.text: Front support leg will not crank, no visible damage. Notify Unit maintenance (malfunction 10). Use four or more persons to lift the drawbar until it is repaired.

terminal.summary: Front support leg will not crank — notify Unit maintenance

ts-q1.text: The trailer leans to one side. Check both tire pressures (Step 1). Are they 17 psi ± 2 psi?

options.label: No — one or both are off

ts-a1.actionText: Inflate both tires to 17 psi ± 2 psi (117 ± 13.8 kPa).

ts-q2.text: Check the shock absorbers for leaks (Step 2). Any leak?

ts-q3.text: Compare the exposed shock absorber extension rods on both sides (Step 3). Are they uneven?

ts-t1.text: Trailer level after correcting tire pressure.

terminal.summary: Trailer lean — tire pressure corrected

ts-t2.text: Leaking shock absorber — NMC (PMCS item 10: any leaks are evident). Notify Unit maintenance.

terminal.summary: Shock absorber leaking — NMC

ts-t3.text: Uneven shock absorber extension rods — notify Unit maintenance (malfunction 11, Step 3). Treat as damage evident (PMCS item 10).

terminal.summary: Trailer lean — uneven shock extension, needs maintenance

ts-t4.text: Trailer still leans with correct pressure, no shock leak, and even rods. Check that the load is evenly distributed (para 2-9) and notify Unit maintenance.

terminal.summary: Trailer lean — no operator-found cause, notify Unit maintenance
